thread.title: Apple iPhone Average Selling Prices Seen Dipping In Next Cycle

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple iPhone Average Selling Prices Seen Dipping In Next Cycle
text:
Apple ( AAPL ) will have a tough time increasing average selling prices with its next-generation iPhones, given consumer pushback over higher prices for its current-generation handsets.
X That's the view of Morgan Stanley analyst Katy Huberty from a note to clients Friday. Huberty predicted that Apple's upcoming 12th-generation iPhones are unlikely to boost the company's average selling prices for smartphones.
She is forecasting average selling prices for iPhones in fiscal 2019 of $730, down 1.8%. Apple's next fiscal year starts Sept. 30.
Apple is unlikely to raise the price of its top-of-the-line model. That's the current iPhone X, which starts at $999, she said. Unit sales volumes dipped this iPhone cycle as consumers balked at higher prices. They also held on to their existing handsets longer.

Please contact customer service CLOSE However, Apple could see an increase to iPhone average selling prices if it boosts the price of a new midrange handset, Huberty said. That handset is expected to have a 6.1-inch LCD screen.
Three New iPhones Coming Analysts expect Apple to release three new iPhone models this fall. In addition to the big-screen LCD phone, Apple is expected to come out with two new OLED screen models. One OLED iPhone will have a 5.8-inch display like the current iPhone X, while the other will have a jumbo 6.5-inch display, she said.
"We see upside to our $730 (ASP) estimate if Apple prices the non-flagship 6.1-inch LCD iPhone at over $700," Huberty said. IPhone average selling prices could rise as much as 2% next year under this scenario, she said.
As is its custom, Apple likely will reduce the prices of its current handsets by $100 each when it comes out with the new iPhones, Huberty said.
She expects iPhone shipments to decline 1% year over year to 215 million units in fiscal 2018. Meanwhile, she sees iPhone revenue growing 13% this year on the back of a strong 14% uplift in average selling prices.
Huberty rates Apple stock as overweight with a price target of 214. Apple dipped 0.3% to 184.92 on the stock market today .
